description: A voltage-controllable affine transform on a two-dimensional position: it translates, then scales, then skews, then rotates

params.text: Blends the translate horizontal amount away from its knob and towards its jack; at the far left it is all knob, at the far right all jack
Blends the scale horizontal amount away from its knob and towards its jack; at the far left it is all knob, at the far right all jack
Moves the position sideways, -5V at the far left and +5V at the far right
Multiplies the horizontal coordinate by 0 at the far left and by 2 at the far right
Blends the translate vertical amount away from its knob and towards its jack; at the far left it is all knob, at the far right all jack
Blends the scale vertical amount away from its knob and towards its jack; at the far left it is all knob, at the far right all jack
Moves the position up and down, -5V at the far left and +5V at the far right
Multiplies the vertical coordinate by 0 at the far left and by 2 at the far right
Blends the skew horizontal amount away from its knob and towards its jack; at the far left it is all knob, at the far right all jack
Adds a share of the vertical coordinate to the horizontal one, -1 at the far left and +1 at the far right
Blends the rotate amount away from its knob and towards its jack; at the far left it is all knob, at the far right all jack
Blends the skew vertical amount away from its knob and towards its jack; at the far left it is all knob, at the far right all jack
Adds a share of the horizontal coordinate to the vertical one, -1 at the far left and +1 at the far right
Turns the position about the origin, nothing at the far left and a full turn at the far right

inputs.text: Channel 1 is the horizontal scaling and channel 2 the vertical; patching this leaves the separate scale jacks unread
Sets the horizontal scaling, 5V meaning a factor of one, taking over from its knob as its modulation trimmer is turned up
Sets the vertical scaling, 5V meaning a factor of one, taking over from its knob as its modulation trimmer is turned up
Channel 1 is the horizontal translation and channel 2 the vertical; patching this leaves the separate translate jacks unread
Sets the horizontal translation directly in volts, taking over from its knob as its modulation trimmer is turned up
Sets the vertical translation directly in volts, taking over from its knob as its modulation trimmer is turned up
Channel 1 is the horizontal skew and channel 2 the vertical; patching this leaves the separate skew jacks unread
Sets the horizontal skew, 5V meaning a factor of one, taking over from its knob as its modulation trimmer is turned up
Sets the vertical skew, 5V meaning a factor of one, taking over from its knob as its modulation trimmer is turned up
Channel 1 is the horizontal position and channel 2 the vertical; patching this leaves the separate X and Y jacks unread
The horizontal position to transform; it is unread while the two-channel input at the top has a cable in it
The vertical position to transform; it is unread while the two-channel input at the top has a cable in it
Sets the rotation, 5V meaning a full turn, taking over from its knob as its modulation trimmer is turned up

outputs.text: Channel 1 carries the transformed horizontal position and channel 2 the transformed vertical one

notes: the four steps are applied in the order printed down the panel: translate, then scale, then skew, then rotate
the vertical skew is worked out from the horizontal coordinate after the horizontal skew has already changed it, so the two skews are not independent
